confidence: segment mu exists but is undocumented; no verified per-point confidence
frame_numbering: frameNo is 1-based; canonical frame_index = frameNo - 1; lookup uses equality
missing_contour: absent mapped identity becomes an empty contour; absent frame is an error
point_order: source v row order retained after filtering by i equality
segments: four zero-based contours.segment entries; no fields literally named R1/R2/R3
